captures.description: THE LIBRARY, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Walter P. Reuther Library, Archives of Labor and Urban Affairs is the largest labor archive in North America, located on the campus of Wayne State University at 5401 Cass Ave in Detroit, Michigan.' History (1960, 1975, 1991); labor, urban and university collections; visiting and research. Seven cards: the library, Wayne State (three), Wikipedia, Project MUSE, DETROITography.
